notes.title: Saving saves
notes.content:
Some users have been reporting that their saves aren't loading properly. This quick little fix makes sure that your hard-earned progress is maintained, so you don't need to do all those levels in one shot and can come back later.

Full patch notes:
- Fixed an issue where saves could fail to load for some users.
- Fixed an issue with unusual physics in the campaign map in some areas

notes.title: Ropey Physics
notes.content:
The ropey physics patch introduces a number of quality of life improvements to the gameplay of Escape the Farm, most noticeably those pesky ropes that tended to go a bit haywire if you pulled them too hard now behave themselves!

Other fixes include:
- Improvements to the physics of certain wooden boards
- Improvements to the terrain in some levels to prevent you leaving them early
- Improvements to the challenge times of some levels to make them more achievable

notes.title: Hotfix for saving
notes.content:
- Fixes an issue where some user's security settings prevented loading their saves
This issue didn't affect the saving process, so exisitng saves are unaffected
